permissions.name: tax:view
permissions.description: See whether tax is connected, where tax is being collected, and the tax categories available

permissions.name: tax:calculate
permissions.description: Ask what tax is owed on a set of items over the API

permissions.name: tax:record
permissions.description: Record a completed sale for tax reporting, or reverse one that was refunded

permissions.name: tax:settings
permissions.description: Change the tax provider, its API key and the default tax category

settings.name: provider
settings.description: Which service works out the tax. Only 'stripe' ships today

settings.name: currency
settings.description: The currency amounts are in when the caller does not name one. ISO 4217, lowercase

settings.name: prices_include_tax
settings.description: Whether the prices passed in already contain tax (VAT-style). Off means tax is added on top (US-style)

settings.name: default_tax_code
settings.description: The Stripe tax category (txcd_…) used for an item that does not name one. Blank uses the default set in the Stripe dashboard

settings.name: shipping_tax_code
settings.description: The Stripe tax category used for shipping charges. Blank uses Stripe's own shipping category

settings.name: stripe_secret_key
settings.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_… or sk_live_…). Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser. Blank falls back to the key kempo-payments holds, if it is installed

groups.name: kempo-tax:viewer
groups.description: Can see whether tax is connected and where it is being collected, without being able to change anything

groups.name: kempo-tax:administrator
groups.description: Everything a viewer can do, plus connecting the site to Stripe and changing the defaults
